decisions.rationale: Dry-stone boundary module, 2 m long, 0.6 m wide, 2.0 m high with a slab coping; repeated along yard and courtyard sides; 20 triangles, 3,016 bytes before meshopt. Walls stay inside the oriented-box collider below 3 m and eaves overhang at most 0.78 m above it (check-kit: OK); baked AO at 48 samples.
limitations: Modules repeat every 2 m with identical stones; long runs show the repeat.
Corners overlap two modules instead of a corner stone.
Surfaces are tiled 2 m layers shared by the whole kit; there is no unique wear, grime gradient or decals per building.

decisions.rationale: In Yards and inn courtyards in stone country (Greenhollow gardens, Saltmarket, Cinderwell, Crownbridge, Roadward, Lantern Ferry, High Pass, Wreckers' Rest) at gameplay cameras (18-40 m, pitch 0.38-1.13): reads at true scale beside the 2.25 m soldier, the 2.7 m captain and the 3.9 m boss; shadows ground it on the relief; the 1.6-3.2 m architecture cutaway keeps the hero visible behind it, and a camera inside its bounds (plus 2 m) hides it instead of showing the hollow inside.
limitations: Not enterable: interiors are not modelled.
Lighting is the overcast day grade only; windows never light up.
